Chapter 1066: 13: Chaos Tree (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3

Chapter 1066: Chapter 13: Chaos Tree (Requesting Monthly Tickets)_3

Lin Yuan decided to perform a ‘Soul Search’ on these four beings at the Path Splitting Realm to gain final confirmation.

Although his perception had already assured him that these four beings were not lying, everything needed to go through a final verification.

“Yes.”

The four figures at the Path Splitting Realm nodded.

At this point, they had no choice but to cooperate.

Even if Lin Yuan killed them after completing the ‘Soul Search,’ there was nothing they could do to stop it.

Buzz.

Soon.

Lin Yuan completed the ‘Soul Search.’

It was essentially consistent with what the four figures at the Path Splitting Realm had stated.

“Nine Profound Venerable?”

Lin Yuan casually sent the four beings, who had fallen into a deep slumber, into his inner cosmos.

Before fully understanding why Nine Profound Venerable treated the Stone People Clan in this manner, he did not want news of his arrival to spread.

Thus, for now, these four beings at the Path Splitting Realm would remain asleep within Lin Yuan’s inner cosmos.

…

Nine Profound Secret Realm.

This was the secret realm where Nine Profound Venerable resided, far more expansive than the secret realm of the Stone People Clan.

Not every venerable would open a Chaos Continent. Nine Profound Venerable had become a venerable only ten Cosmic Eras ago, making him a newly ascended venerable, and opening a Chaos Continent required boundless effort.

At present, Nine Profound Venerable did not have such reserves.

At the highest point of the secret realm, within a grand hall.

“Venerable.” Three strong beings at the Lord Realm bowed respectfully to the thin, sinister-looking elder seated on the throne in the hall.

As a Chaos Realm sovereign, one naturally had a large number of followers. Many at the peak of the Lord Realm found themselves unable to take the next step. At such moments, the guidance of a venerable became critically important.

“So, has that brat agreed to talk?”

Nine Profound Venerable said coldly.

“We’ve immersed him in the Zui Ni Tan, letting unending sins assault his mind and soul, subjecting him to torment seemingly without limits. However…”

The three Lord Realm strongmen exchanged glances, finally replying softly, “That brat refuses to talk.”

“Refuses to talk?”

Nine Profound Venerable frowned.

The ‘brat’ referenced here was named Cang Yulong from the Stone People Clan.

Half a Cosmic Era ago, Nine Profound Venerable wandered the Chaos Void, discovering a twisted spacetime within which he faintly glimpsed a mysterious space.

At that moment, Nine Profound Venerable realized the mysterious space had an extraordinary origin—likely linked to beings at the peak of the Chaos Realm or perhaps even to a Great Saint.

He spent half a Cosmic Era trying to break through the space-time barrier enveloping the mysterious space, seeking entry.

His efforts demanded a tremendous price, even leveraging the favors he had accumulated as a venerable, barely managing to approach the mysterious space.

Just then, a silhouette suddenly emerged within the mysterious space.

The figure appeared out of thin air, evidently entering through some other means of teleportation.

Before Nine Profound Venerable could act, he watched as the figure inside the mysterious space activated it, causing the space to vanish instantly.

Having invested half a Cosmic Era of time, connections, effort, and resources, only to be intercepted at the crucial moment—one can imagine Nine Profound Venerable’s rage.

Afterward, Nine Profound Venerable spent tens of millions of years utilizing the faint karmic link established during his brief encounter with the figure, finally locking onto and capturing him.

The figure turned out to be Cang Yulong.

After capturing Cang Yulong, Nine Profound Venerable intended to directly ‘Soul Search’ him to uncover information regarding the mysterious space.

However, he found that Cang Yulong’s sea of consciousness was protected by a mysterious force.

Forcibly performing ‘Soul Search’ could break the force protecting his sea of consciousness, but would leave Cang Yulong’s mind utterly shattered.

Thus.

To learn of the mysterious space, Nine Profound Venerable had no choice but to make Cang Yulong willingly divulge the information.

Cang Yulong, of course, refused to talk, so Nine Profound Venerable subjected him to endless torture.

In the Nine Profound Secret Realm, there was a natural phenomenon birthed by the Chaos Void, called Zui Ni Tan. It contained boundless sin—any being who came into contact with even a drop of its water would endure unspeakable pain.

To date, Nine Profound Venerable had not discovered a more tormenting method than Zui Ni Tan, so he directly immersed Cang Yulong in it.

Unfortunately.

So far, it had yielded no results.

“Does the brat know his kin are in my grasp?”

Nine Profound Venerable asked.

At first, he hadn’t known Cang Yulong’s origins.

But through repeated investigations, Nine Profound Venerable identified Cang Yulong’s background; though the mysterious force shielding his sea of consciousness was impervious to exploration, his physical body yielded no such immunity.

By analyzing his physical characteristics, Nine Profound Venerable discovered Cang Yulong belonged to the Stone People Clan, ordering the capture of the entire clan.

“He has been informed.”

The three Lord Realm strongmen nodded.

“Tell the brat that for each day he refuses to talk, I will slaughter a billion Stone People, immersing their souls in the Zui Ni Tan as well.”

Nine Profound Venerable’s expression was ruthlessly cold.

“Understood.”

The three Lord Realm strongmen trembled internally. They knew well the horrors of Zui Ni Tan—truth be told, the fact that Cang Yulong had endured so far was already astonishing.

Watching his three Lord Realm subordinates retreat, Nine Profound Venerable’s mind once again conjured images of the mysterious space.

Even though his glimpse of it had been fleeting, Nine Profound Venerable had faintly discerned a towering tree within the space, its branches stretching to uphold the heavens.

The tree swayed gently, surrounded by endless Chaos Qi.

“Chaos Tree.”

Desire flickered in Nine Profound Venerable’s eyes.

If the World Tree was an eleventh-grade supreme treasure.

Then the Chaos Tree was a twelfth-grade supreme treasure.

And twelfth-grade treasures corresponded to the caliber of Great Saints in the Chaos Realm.

Planting a Chaos Tree in his inner cosmos would fundamentally stabilize it, enabling Nine Profound Venerable to reach the peak of the Chaos Realm in record time.

And this was merely one of the Chaos Tree’s countless wonders, for as a twelfth-grade supreme treasure, its potential was incomparably vast.
